data.desc: INmune Bio Inc. (NASDAQ: INMB) develops medicines targeting inflammation and innate immune dysfunction. Its CORDStrom platform uses selected, pooled, allogeneic human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cells to develop disease-specific cellular medicines. Ebstrocel (pobistrocel), the platform's lead product, is being developed as a systemic treatment for RDEB. XPro (XPro1595, pegipanermin) is designed to neutralize soluble TNF while preserving transmembrane TNF signaling. The Company's product candidates remain investigational and have not received marketing approval. Visit www.inmunebio.com for more information.
